provenance.concat_catx_update: DS-029 adds bounded character assignment expressions, concat-catx and suite-concat-catx; new-expression PUT_ALL and C++ remain refused.
provenance.substr_update: DS-030 repairs source-derived SUBSTR destination widths with bounded checked execution, an original base-R twin and appended substr/suite-substr gates. provenance.lag_execution_update: DS-007 source execution adds numeric direct-RHS LAG/DIF occurrence queues, selected conditional/loop invocation, static/context checks and per-step/run reset. Raw queue fixtures remain unchanged; lag-execution/suite-lag-execution add independent prior-invoked-index R evidence. No statement/procedure universe change or live-SAS claim.
provenance.calendar_update: DS-033 calendar/suite-calendar add bounded MDY/WEEKDAY source execution and a full unmodified day_of_the_week.sas proof. Only valid integral numeric dates in1753..3999; invalid/missing/error-state and wider dates remain review boundaries. Function reference universe remains unenumerated; no statement/procedure disposition or rollup changes. No live SAS.
provenance.sum_until_update: DS-034/DS-035 add source sum statements and bounded DO UNTIL, independent R and full unmodified loops_do_while.sas proof. Existing dispositions and rollups remain; no live SAS.
provenance.numeric_while_update: DS-036/037/038 add bounded exact division, safe INT outside conservative near-integer refusals and pre-test DO WHILE, with independent R and the full unmodified loops_while.sas proof. Statement dispositions/rollups and unenumerated function universe remain unchanged; no live SAS.
